basic_profile.bio: I'm a tech enthusiast based in Manchester, UK. I work as a network engineer for a local ISP, which fuels my passion for all things related to connectivity and technology. In my spare time, I enjoy gaming, particularly on weekends, and exploring new music genres. I'm currently single and tend to spend my evenings browsing Reddit and catching up on tech news. I have a keen interest in politics and how technology intersects with society, which is reflected in my frequent visits to various subreddits.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, I've spent the last decade diving deep into network infrastructure and cybersecurity. My expertise is largely self-taught, honed through years of hands-on experience and constant learning. I enjoy sharing my insights and helping others make informed decisions about tech purchases and setups.
